stories.title: The Lighthouse Sneeze
stories.hook: Captain Wally sneezed out the lighthouse lamp! Help the little boats get home.

intro.big: Look! Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops. That's a fish!
intro.little: Look! Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops. That's a fish!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Captain Wally at the lighthouse. He needs our help tonight!
intro.little: Here's the real letter. Captain Wally at the lighthouse needs our help!

intro.big: Captain Wally keeps the light that helps the boats get home. But he has a cold. Sniff, sniff!
intro.little: This is Captain Wally. He has a cold. Sniff, sniff!

intro.big: We climb up, up, up the twisty stairs to the big lamp. Puff, puff, puff!
intro.little: We climb up, up, up the twisty stairs to the big lamp. Puff, puff, puff!

intro.big: Ah... ah... ah-choo! Oh no! Captain Wally sneezed the lamp right out!
intro.little: Ah... ah... ah-choo! Oh no! Captain Wally sneezed the lamp right out!

intro.big: Out on the sea, the little boats are coming home. But it's dark and foggy. Toot, toot? Which way?
intro.little: The little boats can't find their way home. It's too dark!

intro.big: Wally can't find his glasses. They're on his head! And if he gets near the lamp... ah-choo! Out it goes.
intro.little: Wally can't find his glasses. They're on his head! And if he gets near the lamp... ah-choo! Out it goes.

intro.big: So it's up to us! Let's light the lamp, find every boat, and shine them all the way home.
intro.little: Let's light the lamp and find the little boats!

ending.big: Toot, toot, hooray! Every little boat is safe at home.
ending.little: Toot, toot, hooray! Every little boat is safe at home.

ending.big: Even the sleepy whale woke up to say thank you. Splash!
ending.little: Even the sleepy whale woke up to say thank you. Splash!

ending.big: We found Wally's glasses. And this time, his sneeze was a teeny one. Achoo!
ending.little: Look! Wally's glasses were on his head the whole time. Silly Wally!

ending.big: Cocoa for the heroes! You lit the way home. Our helper map gets a gold star, right by the lighthouse.
ending.little: Cocoa for the heroes! You lit the way home. Our helper map gets a gold star, right by the lighthouse.

stories.title: Grandpa Bear's Sleepy Toys
stories.hook: Grandpa Bear's toys are fast asleep. Wake them up for the Toy Parade!

intro.big: Pelly the pelican is here with a letter! Oops. That's a rubber duck. Squeak!
intro.little: Pelly the pelican is here with a letter! Oops. That's a rubber duck. Squeak!

intro.big: It's from Grandpa Bear's toy shop. The Toy Parade is today! Hooray!
intro.little: Grandpa Bear's toys have a parade today. Hooray!

intro.big: The whole town is waiting in the square for the parade. But where are the toys?
intro.little: Everyone is waiting for the parade. Where are the toys?

intro.big: Shh! The toys are fast asleep. They had a secret party all night long!
intro.little: Shh! The toys are fast asleep. They had a secret party all night long!

intro.big: Now they're all out of wind. Their little keys won't turn by themselves.
intro.little: Now they're all out of wind. Their little keys won't turn by themselves.

intro.big: And Grandpa Bear is asleep too. He snores like a tuba! Honk-shoo, honk-shoo.
intro.little: And Grandpa Bear is asleep too. He snores like a tuba! Honk-shoo, honk-shoo.

intro.big: A wind-up toy needs just the right winding. Too little, it yawns. Too much, it spins! Just right, it marches.
intro.little: A wind-up toy needs just the right winding. Too little, it yawns. Too much, it spins! Just right, it marches.

intro.big: Let's wind up every toy and get this parade going. Ready?
intro.little: Let's wind up the toys for the parade. Ready?

ending.big: Here comes the Toy Parade! Rat-a-tat, toot, hop, twirl. Everybody cheers!
ending.little: Here comes the Toy Parade! Rat-a-tat, toot, hop, twirl. Everybody cheers!

ending.big: Grandpa Bear woke up and ran out in his pajamas. Is it parade time? Yes, it is!
ending.little: Grandpa Bear woke up and ran out in his pajamas. Is it parade time? Yes, it is!

ending.big: Look who came to watch! Captain Wally from the lighthouse, with three little mice riding along!
ending.little: Look who came to watch! Captain Wally from the lighthouse, with three little mice riding along!

ending.big: A gold star for Grandpa Bear's toy shop on our helper map! What a day.
ending.little: A gold star for Grandpa Bear's toy shop on our helper map! What a day.

stories.title: The Puzzle Bridge
stories.hook: The storm broke the bridge to Blossom Island. Build it back for the big party!

intro.big: Pelly is here with a letter. Oops. That's a banana. Pelly, you silly bird!
intro.little: Pelly is here with a letter. Oops. That's a banana. Pelly, you silly bird!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. Grandma Tortoise is one hundred years old today! The party is on Blossom Island.
intro.little: It's Grandma Tortoise's birthday! The party is on Blossom Island.

intro.big: Everyone is going. Captain Wally from the lighthouse has the cake, and Grandpa Bear's toys will play the music!
intro.little: Everyone is going. Captain Wally from the lighthouse has the cake, and Grandpa Bear's toys will play the music!

intro.big: But look! Last night's storm shook the old bridge. Its stones fell in the river!
intro.little: Oh no! The storm broke the bridge. Its stones fell in the river!

intro.big: Grandma Tortoise is waving from the island. Nobody can get across to the party!
intro.little: Grandma Tortoise is waving from the island. Nobody can get across to the party!

intro.big: The stones are asleep on the river bottom. When they hear a word, up they float!
intro.little: The stones are asleep on the river bottom. When they hear a word, up they float!

intro.big: Every stone fits just one hole. Turn it the right way, then slide it in. Click!
intro.little: Every stone fits the hole with the same shape. Click!

intro.big: Let's build the bridge back, stone by stone. Ready?
intro.little: Let's fix the bridge, stone by stone. Ready?

ending.big: Click! The last stone fits. The bridge is whole again!
ending.little: Click! The last stone fits. The bridge is whole again!

ending.big: Everyone crosses. Captain Wally carries the cake, and the toys march and play!
ending.little: Everyone crosses. Captain Wally carries the cake, and the toys march and play!

ending.big: Happy birthday, Grandma Tortoise! Everybody sings, and she blows out her candles. Whoosh!
ending.little: Happy birthday, Grandma Tortoise! Whoosh go the candles!

ending.big: A gold star for the bridge on our helper map! You're a super helper.
ending.little: A gold star for the bridge on our helper map! You're a super helper.

stories.title: The Thirsty Waterwheel Garden
stories.hook: Gardener Mouse's flowers are thirsty. Fix the troughs and get her waterwheel turning!

intro.big: Here comes Pelly with a letter! Oops. That's a striped sock. Pelly, where's the other one?
intro.little: Here comes Pelly with a letter! Oops. That's a striped sock. Pelly, where's the other one?

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Gardener Mouse. Her flowers are thirsty, and her waterwheel has stopped!
intro.little: Here's the real letter, from Gardener Mouse. Her flowers need a drink!

intro.big: Up the hill we go, to Gardener Mouse's garden. Oh dear. The flowers are droopy, and the pond is dry.
intro.little: Oh dear. Droopy flowers, an empty pond, and a wheel that won't turn!

intro.big: Two ducks sit in the empty pond with their towels, ready for a swim. Quack? Where's the water?
intro.little: Two ducks sit in the empty pond with their towels, ready for a swim. Quack? Where's the water?

intro.big: Gardener Mouse is watering the whole garden with a teeny watering can. One drop for you. One drop for you!
intro.little: Gardener Mouse has a teeny watering can. Drip, drip!

intro.big: She took her wooden troughs apart to scrub them. Now they're in a heap, and she can't remember how they go!
intro.little: The wooden troughs are slides for the water. Now they're all in a heap!

intro.big: Water runs down the troughs to the wheel, and the wheel scoops it up for the plants. A gap? Splish! It spills out.
intro.little: Water runs down the troughs to the wheel, and the wheel scoops it up for the plants. A gap? Splish! It spills out.

intro.big: Let's fit the troughs back together, open the water gate, and get that wheel turning. Ready?
intro.little: Let's fix the troughs and get the wheel turning. Ready?

ending.big: Gurgle, gurgle! The wheel turns, the water runs, and every droopy flower stands up tall.
ending.little: Gurgle, gurgle! The wheel turns, and the flowers get a big drink!

ending.big: The pond fills right up, and in jump the ducks with a big splash. Quack, quack, hooray!
ending.little: The pond fills right up, and in jump the ducks with a big splash. Quack, quack, hooray!

ending.big: Gardener Mouse puts her feet up. And look! A little frog found Pelly's other sock. It makes a cozy sleeping bag!
ending.little: Look! A little frog found Pelly's other sock!

ending.big: Another gold star for our helper map! And not one droopy flower left in the garden.
ending.little: Another gold star for our helper map! And not one droopy flower left in the garden.

stories.title: The Little Island Postboat
stories.hook: Otter's big boat is stuck in the reeds. Take the parcels in the little postboat!

intro.big: Pelly waddles up with a letter! Oops. That's a teapot. And it's still warm!
intro.little: Pelly waddles up with a letter! Oops. That's a teapot. And it's still warm!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Postmaster Otter, down by the sea. He needs our help!
intro.little: Here's the real letter. Postmaster Otter needs our help!

intro.big: Otter has parcels for everybody on the little islands. Look at that pile!
intro.little: Postmaster Otter has a big pile of parcels!

intro.big: But his big red boat is too wide for the reeds. It got stuck! Squish, squelch.
intro.little: But his big red boat is too wide for the reeds. It got stuck! Squish, squelch.

intro.big: Lucky for us, Otter has a little postboat too. It fits right through the reeds!
intro.little: Otter's big boat won't fit in the reeds. This little one will!

intro.big: Mouse's little blue house has no curtains. Heron keeps getting rained on. And Turtle has read all his books, twice!
intro.little: Mouse's little blue house has no curtains. Heron keeps getting rained on. And Turtle has read all his books, twice!

intro.big: Then there's Beaver. He nibbled his own front door by mistake. Crunch! His new one is on that raft.
intro.little: Silly Beaver nibbled his door. Crunch! His new one is on a raft.

intro.big: Let's steer the little postboat to every island, and pull Beaver's raft behind us. Ready?
intro.little: Let's steer the boat to every island. Ready?

ending.big: Beaver's new door fits just right. Open, shut, open, shut. He loves it!
ending.little: Beaver's new door fits. Hooray!

ending.big: Mouse hangs up her curtains. Turtle starts a new book. And Heron splashes in his new raincoat!
ending.little: Mouse hangs up her curtains. Turtle starts a new book. And Heron splashes in his new raincoat!

ending.big: Tea for everyone from Pelly's teapot! And Beaver nibbles a stick, not his new door.
ending.little: Tea for everyone from Pelly's teapot!

ending.big: Our helper map has a shiny new gold star! You and the little postboat did it.
ending.little: Our helper map has a shiny new gold star! You and the little postboat did it.

stories.title: Breakfast at the Moonberry Bakery
stories.hook: Baker Badger's new bakery opens today, and every tray is empty. Let's bake breakfast!

intro.big: Pelly is up early with a letter. Oops. That's a pinecone! What a prickly letter, Pelly.
intro.little: Pelly is up early with a letter. Oops. That's a pinecone! What a prickly letter, Pelly.

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Baker Badger. His new bakery opens this morning, and he needs more paws!
intro.little: Here's the real letter. Baker Badger's new bakery opens today!

intro.big: The neighbors are already lining up at the Moonberry Bakery. Grandpa Bear from the toy shop brought a very big basket!
intro.little: Everyone is hungry, but there are no buns yet. Rumble, rumble go their tummies!

intro.big: Inside, every tray is empty. Badger is so excited about his new bakery, his paws won't stop wiggling!
intro.little: Inside, every tray is empty. Badger is so excited about his new bakery, his paws won't stop wiggling!

intro.big: Wobble, wobble, poof! The flour goes everywhere. Where did Badger's stripes go?
intro.little: Poof! Flour everywhere. Where did Badger's stripes go?

intro.big: The recipe is all pictures. Pour to the line, stir, then shape round buns, curled buns and berry buns.
intro.little: The recipe is all pictures. Pour it, stir it, shape the buns!

intro.big: Sniff, sniff. Grandpa Bear's nose is squished on the window. Not yet, Grandpa Bear. We haven't even started!
intro.little: Sniff, sniff. Grandpa Bear's nose is squished on the window. Not yet, Grandpa Bear. We haven't even started!

intro.big: Let's mix the dough, shape the buns and bake them golden for the whole street. Ready?
intro.little: Let's bake breakfast for everyone. Ready?

ending.big: Ta-da! Round buns, curled buns and berry buns, each in its own basket. Breakfast is ready!
ending.little: Ta-da! Breakfast is ready. Warm buns, fresh from the oven!

ending.big: Badger opens the door, and in come the neighbors. Good thing Grandpa Bear brought that very big basket!
ending.little: Badger opens the door, and in come the neighbors. Good thing Grandpa Bear brought that very big basket!

ending.big: Pelly flies in for breakfast too. She tucks a bun in her pouch, and out pops another pinecone. Bonk!
ending.little: Pelly puts a bun in her pouch. Out pops another pinecone!

ending.big: There's a gold star by the bakery on our helper map! Badger even gave us the very last curled bun.
ending.little: There's a gold star by the bakery on our helper map! Badger even gave us the very last curled bun.

stories.title: Tortoise's New Front Door
stories.hook: Tortoise is moving today! Build a bridge to his new house and roll his cart across.

intro.big: Pelly flew in with a letter. Oops. That's a toothbrush! Whose is it?
intro.little: Pelly flew in with a letter. Oops. That's a toothbrush! Whose is it?

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Tortoise. He's moving to a new house today, and he needs our help!
intro.little: Here's the real letter. Tortoise has a new house, and he needs our help!

intro.big: Meet Tortoise and his moving cart. His new house is just over the stream. See the green door?
intro.little: This is Tortoise and his cart. His new house is over the stream, but there's no bridge!

intro.big: Tortoise packed his chair, his books and his cozy blanket. But where is his toothbrush?
intro.little: Tortoise packed his chair, his books and his cozy blanket. But where is his toothbrush?

intro.big: Oh no, there's no bridge! The new one is still in pieces, all in a big pile by the water.
intro.little: Oh no, there's no bridge! The new one is still in pieces, all in a big pile by the water.

intro.big: Tortoise tries to carry a long plank on his shell. Round and round he spins! Whoa, whoops!
intro.little: Tortoise tries to carry a big piece of wood. Round and round he spins. Whoops!

intro.big: Here's a crane to help! Hook the wood, lift it, turn it to fit, and lower it onto its glowing spot.
intro.little: Here's a crane! It lifts the wood. Turn it to fit, then down it goes. Clunk!

intro.big: Let's put the bridge together, roll Tortoise's cart to his green door, and ring his doorbell. Ready?
intro.little: Let's build a bridge, then roll Tortoise's cart to his door. Ready?

ending.big: Ding-dong! Tortoise's cart rolls across our new bridge, all the way to his green door.
ending.little: Ding-dong! Tortoise's cart made it to his green door!

ending.big: Chair by the window, books on the shelf, blanket on the bed. Tortoise does a happy dance, a very slow one!
ending.little: Chair by the window, books on the shelf, blanket on the bed. Tortoise does a happy dance, a very slow one!

ending.big: Pelly is back, and look! That toothbrush is Tortoise's. He sent it with his letter by mistake!
ending.little: Pelly brings the toothbrush. It's Tortoise's! Brush, brush!

ending.big: Tortoise is home, and his green door gets a gold star on our helper map!
ending.little: Tortoise is home, and his green door gets a gold star on our helper map!

stories.title: The Glowworm Lantern Walk
stories.hook: Glowworm's hiccups popped out the lamp plugs! Light up the woods for his lantern walk.

intro.big: Pelly swoops down with a letter! Oops. That's a carrot! Somebody is going to love that.
intro.little: Pelly swoops down with a letter! Oops. That's a carrot! Somebody is going to love that.

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Glowworm in the Mushroom Woods. He needs our help with his lamps tonight!
intro.little: Here's the real letter. Glowworm needs our help with his lamps!

intro.big: Into the Mushroom Woods we go. Hello, Glowworm! Rabbit and Hedgehog are here for the lantern walk too.
intro.little: Hello, Glowworm! Hello, Rabbit and Hedgehog!

intro.big: Every evening, Glowworm leads a walk down the lamp path to the big lantern, to hear the crickets sing.
intro.little: Every evening, Glowworm leads a walk down the lamp path to the big lantern, to hear the crickets sing.

intro.big: Oh dear, Glowworm has the hiccups. And every hiccup makes him hop! Hic, hop! Hic, hop!
intro.little: Glowworm has the hiccups! Hic, hop! Hic, hop!

intro.big: He hopped right into the lamp cords. Pop, pop, pop! Now every plug is out, and the lamps won't light.
intro.little: He hopped on the cords. Pop, pop, pop! Out came the plugs. The lamps won't light!

intro.big: Every light needs two cords. One takes the power in, one brings it back. Then flip the switch. Click!
intro.little: Every light needs two cords. One takes the power in, one brings it back. Then flip the switch. Click!

intro.big: Let's plug in every cord and flip every switch, lamp by lamp, right up to the big lantern. Ready?
intro.little: Let's plug in the cords and switch on the lamps. Ready?

ending.big: Click! The great big lantern glows gold. Every lamp shines, and the stepping stones glow like little moons!
ending.little: Click! The big lantern glows. Every lamp is shining!

ending.big: Glowworm leads the walk down the shining path. Then we all sit and listen to the crickets. Chirp, chirp!
ending.little: Glowworm leads the walk down the shining path. Then we all sit and listen to the crickets. Chirp, chirp!

ending.big: Pelly's carrot was for Rabbit all along! Crunch, crunch. And Glowworm's hiccups are almost gone... hic!
ending.little: Pelly's carrot was for Rabbit! Crunch, crunch!

ending.big: Goodnight, Glowworm! Now the Mushroom Woods have a gold star on our helper map.
ending.little: Goodnight, Glowworm! Now the Mushroom Woods have a gold star on our helper map.

stories.title: All Aboard for Snowdrop Valley
stories.hook: The new valley train has no tracks! Lay the tracks and take everyone to their stop.

intro.big: Pelly lands on the doorstep with a letter. Oops. That's a fuzzy red mitten! Pelly, it isn't even snowing here.
intro.little: Pelly lands on the doorstep with a letter. Oops. That's a fuzzy red mitten! Pelly, it isn't even snowing here.

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Hare in snowy Snowdrop Valley. She needs help with her brand-new train!
intro.little: Here's the real letter. It's from Hare, out in the snow!

intro.big: Hare and Frog are the train crew. Here's their shiny new train. But look! There are no tracks!
intro.little: Hare and Frog have a shiny new train. But it has no tracks!

intro.big: Hare and Frog polished the train all week. They forgot the tracks! They're still on the cart, under the snow.
intro.little: Hare and Frog polished the train all week. They forgot the tracks! They're still on the cart, under the snow.

intro.big: Squirrel wants to go sledding. Baker Badger has a day off and wants a nap. The duck family wants a swim!
intro.little: Squirrel, Badger and the duck family all need a ride!

intro.big: Frog gave Badger a ride home on his back. One hop, two hops, plop! They landed in a snowdrift, giggling.
intro.little: Frog gave Badger a ride. One hop, two hops, plop! Into the snow!

intro.big: Every stop has a picture sign. A sled for the hill, a little house for Badger, and a duck for the pond.
intro.little: Every stop has a picture sign. A sled for the hill, a little house for Badger, and a duck for the pond.

intro.big: Let's lay the tracks and drive everyone to their stop. Then Hare and Frog get a ride too. Ready?
intro.little: Let's build the tracks and give everyone a ride. Ready?

ending.big: Ding, ding! Everyone is at their stop. And Hare and Frog got their ride too, round the valley and home!
ending.little: Ding, ding! Everyone got a ride on the train!

ending.big: Down the hill zooms Squirrel! Badger waves from his door in his slippers, and the ducklings paddle in the pond.
ending.little: Down the hill zooms Squirrel! Badger waves from his door in his slippers, and the ducklings paddle in the pond.

ending.big: Hot cocoa and cookies at the station! And here comes Pelly, wearing that red mitten as a cozy hat.
ending.little: Look! Pelly is wearing the mitten as a hat!

ending.big: The whole valley can ride the train now. Up goes a gold star on our helper map!
ending.little: The whole valley can ride the train now. Up goes a gold star on our helper map!

stories.title: The Hilltop Patchwork Kite
stories.hook: Goat's giant kite isn't sewn yet. Stitch it, balance it, and fly it high!

intro.big: Pelly sails in on the breeze with a letter. Oops. That's an umbrella! How did it ever fit in her pouch?
intro.little: Pelly sails in on the breeze with a letter. Oops. That's an umbrella! How did it ever fit in her pouch?

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Goat on Breezy Hill. His giant kite needs our help!
intro.little: Here's the real letter. Goat's giant kite needs our help!

intro.big: Up on windy Breezy Hill, Goat shows us his giant kite. All his friends painted pictures for it!
intro.little: Goat shows us his giant kite. His friends painted pictures for it!

intro.big: Lamb painted a flower for the kite. And Beetle painted a picture of herself!
intro.little: Lamb painted a flower for the kite. And Beetle painted a picture of herself!

intro.big: But the pictures aren't sewn on yet. Whoosh! Every time the wind blows, up they flip and flap.
intro.little: The pictures aren't sewn on. Whoosh! Up they flap!

intro.big: Goat grabbed a needle to sew them on. But that's tricky with hooves! Now he's wrapped up like a present.
intro.little: Sewing is tricky with hooves. Goat is all tangled up!

intro.big: A kite's tail has to hang even. Too many bows on one side, and it tips over! Spread them out, and it flies straight.
intro.little: A kite's tail has to hang even. Too many bows on one side, and it tips over! Spread them out, and it flies straight.

intro.big: Let's sew every picture in its place, thread the ribbons, balance the tail and fly the kite. Ready?
intro.little: Let's sew on the pictures, add the ribbon tail and fly! Ready?

ending.big: Look at it go! Up goes the patchwork kite, straight and steady, with every picture flying high!
ending.little: Up goes the kite! Every picture is flying!

ending.big: Lamb waves up at her flower. And Beetle waves up at herself, flying high!
ending.little: Lamb waves up at her flower. And Beetle waves up at herself, flying high!

ending.big: Pelly comes to watch. Pop! Her umbrella opens, and the breeze lifts her up like a kite. Hold on, Pelly!
ending.little: Pop! Pelly's umbrella opens. Up she floats like a kite!

ending.big: Hooray for Goat's kite, and for a new gold star on our helper map!
ending.little: Hooray for Goat's kite, and for a new gold star on our helper map!

stories.title: The Sandstone Nest Lift
stories.hook: Mama Swallow's bundles won't fit up the stairs. Balance the basket lift and carry them up!

intro.big: Pelly has the mail! Oops. That's a wooden spoon. Are you making soup, Pelly?
intro.little: Pelly has the mail! Oops. That's a wooden spoon. Silly Pelly!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Mama Swallow. Her family is moving into new nests on a cliff!
intro.little: Here's the real letter. Mama Swallow is moving into new nests!

intro.big: This is Sandstone Cliff, with little round nests all the way up. Mama Swallow and her chicks wave hello!
intro.little: Look! Mama Swallow and her three chicks. Their new nests are way up high!

intro.big: Uh-oh! The blankets and toys are all bundled up, and the bundles can't squeeze up the little cliff stairs.
intro.little: Oh no! The blankets and toys are too big for the stairs!

intro.big: Mama Swallow took off with the enormous quilt. Flap, flap, flop! Down it came, and now it's a quilt with feet.
intro.little: Flap, flap, flop! The big quilt fell on Mama Swallow. A quilt with feet!

intro.big: Each chick wants its own toy in bed tonight. A rabbit, a teddy bear, and a very, very long snake!
intro.little: Each chick wants its own toy in bed tonight. A rabbit, a teddy bear, and a very, very long snake!

intro.big: Here's the basket lift! A bundle in one basket, stones with just as many dots in the other. Then up it goes!
intro.little: Here's the basket lift! A bundle in one basket, stones with just as many dots in the other. Then up it goes!

intro.big: Let's balance each bundle with stones, wind it up, up, up, and pop it into its nest. Ready?
intro.little: Here's a basket lift! Let's carry the blankets and toys up to the nests. Ready?

ending.big: Swoosh! The enormous quilt slides right into the top nest. Every nest has its bundle!
ending.little: Swoosh! The big quilt fits in the top nest!

ending.big: Soup's on! Pelly stirs berry soup with her wooden spoon. So that's what it was for!
ending.little: Soup's on! Pelly stirs berry soup with her wooden spoon. So that's what it was for!

ending.big: Bedtime! Each chick snuggles in its own nest with its toy. And up top, Mama Swallow is a quilt with feet again!
ending.little: Bedtime! Each chick hugs its toy in its own nest. And look, a quilt with feet!

ending.big: A gold star for Mama Swallow's cliff on our helper map! Every chick is snug in its new nest.
ending.little: A gold star for Mama Swallow's cliff on our helper map! Every chick is snug in its new nest.

stories.title: The Lily-Pad Concert
stories.hook: Frog, Newt and Duck all play at once. Be their conductor at the pond concert!

intro.big: Hello, Pelly! Is that a letter? Oops. That's a sandwich. One bite is already gone!
intro.little: Hello, Pelly! Is that a letter? Oops. That's a sandwich. One bite is already gone!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Frog the drummer. The pond concert is today, but his band can't get started!
intro.little: Here's the real letter. Frog's band needs our help with their concert!

intro.big: At Lily Pond, here's Frog with his band! He has a drum, Newt has a reed harp, and Duck has two little bells.
intro.little: Here's the pond band! Frog has a drum, Newt has a harp, and Duck has bells.

intro.big: Each one knows a lovely tune. Boom, boom goes the drum. Plink, plonk go the reeds. Ding, ding go the bells!
intro.little: Each one knows a lovely tune. Boom, boom goes the drum. Plink, plonk go the reeds. Ding, ding go the bells!

intro.big: Nobody knows who goes first, so they all play at once. Boom, plink, ding! A bunny and a mouse cover their ears.
intro.little: They all play at once. Boom, plink, ding! Oh dear, what a mix-up!

intro.big: And Newt's curly tail keeps plucking the reeds all by itself. Plink, plonk! Oops, silly tail!
intro.little: And Newt's silly tail keeps plucking her harp. Plink, plink!

intro.big: Everyone needs their own seat, with room to play. Then a conductor waves a hand to show who goes next!
intro.little: Everyone needs their own seat, with room to play. Then a conductor waves a hand to show who goes next!

intro.big: Let's play their tunes, give each one a seat, pick who goes first, and be the conductor. Ready?
intro.little: Let's play their music and help them play together. Ready?

ending.big: Everyone takes a turn, and the band plays one lovely song together. The last note floats across the pond.
ending.little: Everyone takes a turn. What a lovely song!

ending.big: The bunny and the mouse pat the water. Splish, splash! And this time, nobody covers their ears.
ending.little: The bunny and the mouse pat the water. Splish, splash! And this time, nobody covers their ears.

ending.big: Pelly shares her sandwich with the band. And Newt's tail plays one last plink, right on time!
ending.little: Pelly shares her sandwich. And Newt's tail goes plink!

ending.big: Take a bow, conductor! Here's a gold star for Lily Pond on our helper map.
ending.little: Take a bow! A gold star for the pond on our helper map.

stories.title: Seeds Across the Rooftops
stories.hook: No seeds on the rooftops yet! Help Gardener Bird send them up with her springboard.

intro.big: Knock, knock! It's Pelly with a letter. Oops. That's a pancake, with butter on top! Silly Pelly.
intro.little: Knock, knock! It's Pelly with a letter. Oops. That's a pancake, with butter on top! Silly Pelly.

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Gardener Bird. Her rooftop gardens need seeds, and lots of them!
intro.little: Here's the real letter. Gardener Bird has seeds to plant!

intro.big: Off we go to the hilltop town! Every rooftop has a planter full of soil. But nothing is growing.
intro.little: Look at all the rooftop pots. Lots of soil, but no plants!

intro.big: The seed pods are too heavy for Gardener Bird to fly up. And her cart gets stuck at the narrow stairs. Bump!
intro.little: The seed cart gets stuck at the skinny stairs. Bump!

intro.big: Gardener Bird loves watering so much, she waters everything. The stairs, the cart, and us! Sprinkle!
intro.little: Gardener Bird waters everything. Even us! Sprinkle, sprinkle!

intro.big: Beside the cart stands a springboard for seed pods. Pop one in the cup, pull the spring, and boing! Up it flies.
intro.little: Beside the cart stands a springboard for seed pods. Pop one in the cup, pull the spring, and boing! Up it flies.

intro.big: One planter hides under a little roof. So we bounce a pod off the striped awning. Boing, plop!
intro.little: One planter hides under a little roof. So we bounce a pod off the striped awning. Boing, plop!

intro.big: Let's aim the springboard, send a seed pod to every rooftop planter, and make the old arch bloom. Ready?
intro.little: Boing! This springboard sends seeds up high. Let's fill every rooftop pot. Ready?

ending.big: Plop! Every seed is planted. Green leaves on every rooftop, and flowers all over the old arch!
ending.little: Plop! Green leaves and flowers on every rooftop!

ending.big: Gardener Bird loops through the flowery arch, watering every new plant. Quick, a leaf umbrella!
ending.little: Gardener Bird loops through the flowery arch, watering every new plant. Quick, a leaf umbrella!

ending.big: Out of Pelly's pouch comes a whole stack of pancakes! A rooftop picnic for everyone. Yum!
ending.little: Pelly brought pancakes for everyone. Yum!

ending.big: A garden on every rooftop, and a brand-new gold star on our helper map!
ending.little: A garden on every rooftop, and a brand-new gold star on our helper map!

stories.title: The Moving-Star Observatory
stories.hook: Owl's wooden sun, moon and stars won't move. Fit the gears and turn the big wheel!

intro.big: Pelly brought us a letter! Oops. That's a fluffy slipper. Pelly, you don't wear slippers!
intro.little: Pelly brought us a letter! Oops. That's a fluffy slipper. Pelly, you don't wear slippers!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Owl at the Moving-Star Observatory. Her stars have stopped moving!
intro.little: Here's the real letter, from Owl. Her stars are stuck!

intro.big: Owl opens the round doors in just one fluffy slipper. So that's whose it is! Here you go, Owl.
intro.little: Owl has one fluffy slipper on. Here's the other one!

intro.big: Owl sleeps all day, so now it's her breakfast time. At night! Good morning, Owl!
intro.little: Owl sleeps all day, so now it's her breakfast time. At night! Good morning, Owl!

intro.big: After breakfast, look at Owl's wooden sky! A painted sun, a silver moon and a ring of golden stars.
intro.little: Look up! A wooden sun, a moon and lots of stars.

intro.big: Tonight is the Sky Show. Owl turns the big wheel, but nothing moves. The gears are still in their tray!
intro.little: Owl turns the big wheel. Nothing moves! The gears are in a pile.

intro.big: Owl shows us the trick. Too small, a gear can't reach. Too big, it squeezes! Just right, round they go.
intro.little: Owl shows us the trick. Too small, a gear can't reach. Too big, it squeezes! Just right, round they go.

intro.big: Let's fit the gears and turn the big wheel, so the sun, moon and stars move again. Ready?
intro.little: Let's fit the gears and turn the wheel. Ready?

ending.big: The sun goes up, the moon goes round, and the stars spin. And the roof opens to the real stars!
ending.little: The sun goes up, and the moon and stars go round!

ending.big: Look at the little pictures going round! A boat, a bridge, a flower and a kite. Just like our adventures!
ending.little: Look at the little pictures going round! A boat, a bridge, a flower and a kite. Just like our adventures!

ending.big: Everyone comes to the Sky Show. And Owl dances under the stars in both fluffy slippers!
ending.little: Owl dances in her two fluffy slippers. Shuffle, shuffle!

ending.big: A new gold star on our helper map, shining bright! What a helper you are!
ending.little: A new gold star on our helper map, shining bright! What a helper you are!

stories.title: Robo's Rocket
stories.hook: Robo the robot built a rocket, but it won't wake up. Help him fly it!

intro.big: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a big red boot!
intro.little: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a big red boot!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Robo the robot. Come quick, he needs our help!
intro.little: The real letter is from Robo the robot. Come quick!

intro.big: We hurry down the bumpy road to Robo's workshop on the hill.
intro.little: We hurry down the bumpy road to Robo's workshop on the hill.

intro.big: Robo built a shiny rocket to fly to the moon. But it's fast asleep! Let's wake up the rocket.
intro.little: Robo built a rocket. It's fast asleep! Let's wake up the rocket.

intro.big: Blink, blink! The rocket woke up! Now Robo needs a rope to tie the fuel tank on.
intro.little: Blink, blink! It woke up! Now we need a rope.

intro.big: A little raccoon pops out of a box, holding the rope. Thank you, raccoon!
intro.little: A little raccoon pops out of a box, holding the rope. Thank you, raccoon!

intro.big: Everyone climbs in and buckles up. Robo looks at us. Are we ready?
intro.little: We climb in and buckle up. Are we ready?

intro.big: Three, two, one... the rocket rumbles and glows. Let's rise up into the sky!
intro.little: Three, two, one... let's rise up into the sky!

ending.big: Whoosh! We zoom up past a giant rainbow, higher and higher.
ending.little: Whoosh! We zoom past a giant rainbow!

ending.big: We land on the moon, and a fluffy moon rabbit hops over to wave hello.
ending.little: We land on the moon, and a fluffy moon rabbit hops over to wave hello.

ending.big: Robo gives us a shiny ring that glows like the stars. Thank you, friends!
ending.little: Robo gives us a shiny ring. Thank you, friends!

ending.big: What a ride! A gold star for Robo's workshop on our helper map!
ending.little: What a ride! A gold star for our helper map!

stories.title: Lulu's Lantern Party
stories.hook: Lulu the little lamb is stuck on an island, and the lanterns are dark. Help bring her home!

intro.big: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a big yellow lemon!
intro.little: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a big yellow lemon!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Lulu the little lamb. Come to her lantern party by the lake tonight!
intro.little: The real letter is from Lulu the little lamb. Come to her lantern party!

intro.big: We hurry down the hill through the crunchy leaves. The sun is going down over the lake.
intro.little: We hurry down the hill through the crunchy leaves. The sun is going down over the lake.

intro.big: We made it to the lake, but the lanterns are dark. Where is Lulu? Let's light the lanterns!
intro.little: The lanterns are dark. Where is Lulu? Let's light the lanterns!

intro.big: Glow, glow! There's Lulu on a little island. Her lily pads floated away! Let's bring them back.
intro.little: There's Lulu on a little island! Let's bring back the lily pads.

intro.big: Pop, pop, pop! Big round lily pads float back in a line across the lake. Ready, set, leap!
intro.little: Pop, pop, pop! Big round lily pads float back in a line across the lake. Ready, set, leap!

intro.big: Hop, hop, hop! We made it, and Lulu gives us a big hug. Now let's all float home on a log!
intro.little: We hop to Lulu, and she hugs us! Let's float home on a log.

intro.big: Here comes a big round log! It floats us home, and the party can start. Let's lift the lanterns up to the sky!
intro.little: The log floats us home. Let's lift the lanterns up to the sky!

ending.big: Up, up, up! The lanterns float over the lake like little glowing moons.
ending.little: Up, up! The lanterns float over the lake!

ending.big: Hee hee! A tiny ladybug with a tiny lantern lands right on Lulu's nose. Hello, ladybug!
ending.little: Hee hee! A tiny ladybug with a tiny lantern lands right on Lulu's nose. Hello, ladybug!

ending.big: Lulu gives us a little lantern of our very own. Thank you, friends!
ending.little: Lulu gives us a little lantern. Thank you, friends!

ending.big: What a lovely night! A gold star for Lulu's lake on our helper map!
ending.little: What a lovely night! A gold star for our helper map!

stories.title: Fizz and the Sleepy Fireflies
stories.hook: Fizz the fox's party is tonight, but the fireflies are too sleepy to glow. Help wake them up!

intro.big: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a giant fork! Are you hungry, Pelly?
intro.little: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a giant fork! Are you hungry, Pelly?

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Fizz the little fox. Come quick, she needs our help!
intro.little: The real letter is from Fizz the fox. Come quick!

intro.big: We hurry down the twisty path, deep into the forest, where Fizz is having a party.
intro.little: We hurry down the twisty path, deep into the forest, where Fizz is having a party.

intro.big: Fizz's party is tonight, but the fireflies are too sleepy to glow. Let's tickle them with a feather!
intro.little: The fireflies are too sleepy for the party! Let's tickle them with a feather.

intro.big: Tickle, tickle! The fireflies giggle and glow! Now they can light up the fairy lights.
intro.little: Tickle, tickle! They glow! Now let's light the fairy lights.

intro.big: The fireflies zip along the fairy lights, and they twinkle on! A shy little fawn peeks out. Hi, fawn!
intro.little: The fireflies zip along the fairy lights, and they twinkle on! A shy little fawn peeks out. Hi, fawn!

intro.big: Fizz pours fizzy berry juice for everyone. The bubbles tickle the fawn's nose! Are we ready?
intro.little: Fizz pours fizzy juice for everyone. Are we ready?

intro.big: Three, two, one... the fireflies swirl up into a big glowing ball. Let's make firefly fireworks!
intro.little: Three, two, one... let's make firefly fireworks!

ending.big: Whoosh! The fireflies burst into golden sparkles all over the sky. Let's dance on our happy feet!
ending.little: Whoosh! Golden sparkles everywhere! Let's dance on our happy feet!

ending.big: We dance in a circle under the twinkly lights. Now it's time for the yummy party food!
ending.little: We dance in a circle under the twinkly lights. Now it's time for the yummy party food!

ending.big: Fizz gives us a pretty paper fan, dotted with gold like the fireflies. Thank you, friends!
ending.little: Fizz gives us a pretty paper fan. Thank you, friends!

ending.big: What fun! A gold star for Fizz's forest on our helper map!
ending.little: What fun! A gold star for our helper map!

stories.title: Sandy's Sandcastle
stories.hook: Sandy the sea turtle's sandcastle keeps falling down. Help her build it!

intro.big: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a bowl of soup!
intro.little: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a bowl of soup!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Sandy the sea turtle. Come quick, she needs our help!
intro.little: The real letter is from Sandy the sea turtle. Come quick!

intro.big: We hop in a little boat. Up goes the sail, and off we go to Sandy's beach!
intro.little: We hop in a little boat. Up goes the sail, and off we go to Sandy's beach!

intro.big: Sandy's big beach party is today, but plop! Her sandcastle keeps falling down. Let's build up the sandcastle!
intro.little: Plop! Sandy's sandcastle keeps falling down. Let's build up the sandcastle!

intro.big: Whoosh! Up goes the sandcastle, tall and round. Now it needs seven pretty shells!
intro.little: Whoosh! Up it goes! Now it needs seven pretty shells.

intro.big: A little seal pops out of the waves with seven shells on her nose. Thank you, seal!
intro.little: A little seal pops out of the waves with seven shells on her nose. Thank you, seal!

intro.big: Pat, pat, pat! On go the shells. Our sandcastle is ready. Now it's time for the sunset party!
intro.little: Pat, pat! It's ready. Now it's time for the sunset party!

intro.big: The sky turns pink and gold. Uh oh! A big, bubbly wave is rolling in. Let's save our sandcastle!
intro.little: Uh oh! A big wave is rolling in. Let's save our sandcastle!

ending.big: Swoosh! The wave turns around and rolls back to the sea. Our sandcastle is safe! Let's sing!
ending.little: Swoosh! The wave rolls away. Our sandcastle is safe! Let's sing!

ending.big: A little seahorse bobs up out of the waves to sing along with us. What a party!
ending.little: A little seahorse bobs up out of the waves to sing along with us. What a party!

ending.big: Sandy gives us a shiny silver shell. We hold it close and hear the sea. Thank you, friends!
ending.little: Sandy gives us a shiny silver shell. Thank you, friends!

ending.big: What a super day! A gold star for Sandy's beach on our helper map!
ending.little: What a super day! A gold star for our helper map!

stories.title: Zippy's Zoo Parade
stories.hook: Zippy the zebra's parade float is stuck, and the zoo parade can't start. Help it go!

intro.big: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a big green zucchini!
intro.little: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a big green zucchini!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Zippy the zebra. Come quick, the zoo parade is stuck!
intro.little: The real letter is from Zippy the zebra. Come quick!

intro.big: Off we go, down the twisty path to the zoo. There's the big striped gate!
intro.little: Off we go, down the twisty path to the zoo. There's the big striped gate!

intro.big: Oh no! Zippy's parade float is stuck. Its lights are off, and it can't move. Let's give it a zap!
intro.little: Oh no! Zippy's parade float is stuck. Let's give it a zap!

intro.big: Zap! The lights glow, and Zippy's mane goes boing! A parade needs music. Let's call the zookeeper!
intro.little: Zap! The lights glow! Now we need music. Let's call the zookeeper!

intro.big: Here comes the zookeeper, a kind elephant, rolling a big, bright xylophone!
intro.little: Here comes the zookeeper, a kind elephant, rolling a big, bright xylophone!

intro.big: Plink, plonk! The music plays. Zippy stands up tall in his parade jacket. Up goes the zipper!
intro.little: The zookeeper plays music! Up goes Zippy's zipper!

intro.big: Everyone hops on the float, and the lights twinkle. Ready? Three, two, one... zero!
intro.little: Everyone hops on! Three, two, one... zero!

ending.big: The float rolls out, the music plays, and the zoo parade begins! Let's zoom!
ending.little: The parade begins! Let's zoom!

ending.big: Whee! We zigzag past the monkey in the tree and the hippo in the pond. Hooray!
ending.little: Whee! We zigzag past the monkey in the tree and the hippo in the pond. Hooray!

ending.big: Zippy hugs us and gives us a little striped flag. Now it's time to zip home!
ending.little: Zippy gives us a striped flag. Let's zip home!

ending.big: A zillion cheers for Zippy! A gold star for Zippy's zoo on our helper map!
ending.little: A zillion cheers! A gold star for our helper map!

stories.title: Kiki's Camping Night
stories.hook: The wind blew Kiki the kitten's tent down before camping night. Help fix her camp!

intro.big: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a big birthday cake!
intro.little: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a big birthday cake!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Kiki the kitten. Come camping with her tonight!
intro.little: The real letter is from Kiki the kitten. Come camping!

intro.big: We paddle a little canoe across the lake to Kiki's camp in the woods.
intro.little: We paddle a little canoe across the lake to Kiki's camp in the woods.

intro.big: Kiki's camp is a mess! The wind blew her tent down. Let's fix up the camp!
intro.little: The wind blew Kiki's tent down! Let's fix up the camp!

intro.big: We pull the cord nice and tight, and up pops the tent!
intro.little: We pull the cord, and up pops the tent!

intro.big: A sleepy koala peeks out of a tree and drops us a cozy blanket. Thank you, koala!
intro.little: A sleepy koala peeks out of a tree and drops us a cozy blanket. Thank you, koala!

intro.big: The sun goes down. Kiki pours warm cocoa for everyone. Yum!
intro.little: Kiki pours warm cocoa. Yum!

intro.big: The sky gets dark, and the stars come out. Let's count the stars!
intro.little: The stars come out! Let's count the stars!

ending.big: Whoosh! A bright comet zooms across the sky with a long, glowing tail.
ending.little: Whoosh! A bright comet zooms by!

ending.big: We each eat a big cookie by the campfire and giggle at the owl's silly hoots.
ending.little: We each eat a big cookie by the campfire and giggle at the owl's silly hoots.

ending.big: Kiki gives us a big cuddle and a tiny toy tent. Thank you, friends!
ending.little: Kiki gives us a cuddle. Thank you, friends!

ending.big: You were so kind! A gold star for Kiki's camp on our helper map!
ending.little: You were so kind! A gold star for our helper map!

stories.title: Gus's Goose Chase
stories.hook: Gus the goat's geese waddled away from the farm. Help find every one!

intro.big: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a little guitar!
intro.little: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a little guitar!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Gus the goat. Come quick, his geese got out!
intro.little: The real letter is from Gus the goat. Come quick!

intro.big: We run up the farm lane. Oh no, the wooden gate is wide open!
intro.little: We run up the farm lane. Oh no, the wooden gate is wide open!

intro.big: Gus has five geese, and they all waddled away! Let's find every goose.
intro.little: Gus's geese waddled away! Let's find every goose.

intro.big: Honk, honk! Two geese are in the garden, nibbling the lettuce.
intro.little: Honk! Two geese are in the garden!

intro.big: A friendly gopher pops out of a hole and waves us to the pond. Thank you, gopher!
intro.little: A friendly gopher pops out of a hole and waves us to the pond. Thank you, gopher!

intro.big: Splash! Two more geese are swimming in the pond. They giggle and flap!
intro.little: Two more geese are in the pond! They giggle and flap!

intro.big: One more goose to find! Let's gallop up the hill to look.
intro.little: One more! Let's gallop up the hill!

ending.big: There she is, sitting on a golden egg! Every goose is home.
ending.little: She's sitting on a golden egg! Every goose is home.

ending.big: We play silly farm games with Gus and all five geese.
ending.little: We play silly farm games with Gus and all five geese.

ending.big: Gus gives us a gift, a soft little feather. Thank you, friends!
ending.little: Gus gives us a gift. Thank you, friends!

ending.big: Goodbye, Gus! A gold star for Gus's farm on our helper map!
ending.little: Goodbye, Gus! A gold star for our helper map!

stories.title: Shelly's Shell Show
stories.hook: The waves washed away Shelly the shark's shells before her show. Help find them!

intro.big: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a fuzzy pink shoe!
intro.little: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a fuzzy pink shoe!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Shelly the shark. Come quick, she needs our help!
intro.little: The real letter is from Shelly the shark. Come quick!

intro.big: We walk along the sandy shore to Shelly's little blue cove.
intro.little: We walk along the sandy shore to Shelly's little blue cove.

intro.big: Shelly's shell show is today, but the waves washed her shells away! Let's find the shells.
intro.little: The waves washed Shelly's shells away! Let's find the shells.

intro.big: We dig in the sand with a little shovel. Look, a pink shell!
intro.little: We dig with a little shovel. A pink shell!

intro.big: An old toy ship is stuck in the sand, and a stripy shell is hiding inside!
intro.little: An old toy ship is stuck in the sand, and a stripy shell is hiding inside!

intro.big: Under a rock, a shiny shell sparkles in the water. Just one more to go!
intro.little: A shiny shell sparkles in the water!

intro.big: Where is the last shell? Let's shake the seaweed and see!
intro.little: Let's shake the seaweed and see!

ending.big: Plop! Out falls the last shell. Every shell is back, and they shine in the sun!
ending.little: Every shell is back, and they shine!

ending.big: The shell show begins, and all the little fish swim close to look.
ending.little: The shell show begins, and all the little fish swim close to look.

ending.big: Shelly lets us share her very best shell. Thank you, friends!
ending.little: Shelly lets us share her best shell. Thank you!

ending.big: Let's shout hooray! A gold star for Shelly's cove on our helper map!
ending.little: Let's shout hooray! A gold star for our helper map!

stories.title: Chip's Cherry Pie
stories.hook: A bird flew off with Chip the chipmunk's cherries. Help him bake his pie!

intro.big: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a tiny wooden chair!
intro.little: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a tiny wooden chair!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Chip the chipmunk. Come to his picnic!
intro.little: The real letter is from Chip the chipmunk. Come to his picnic!

intro.big: We follow the puffs of smoke from Chip's chimney through the woods.
intro.little: We follow the puffs of smoke from Chip's chimney through the woods.

intro.big: Chip wants to bake a cherry pie for the picnic, but his cherries are gone! Let's find the cherries.
intro.little: Chip's cherries are gone! Let's find the cherries.

intro.big: A cheeky bird flew off with them! Let's chase the bird to the big tree.
intro.little: A bird took them! Let's chase the bird!

intro.big: Up in the nest, a little chick hands down the basket of cherries. Thank you, chick!
intro.little: Up in the nest, a little chick hands down the basket of cherries. Thank you, chick!

intro.big: Back at home, we chop and stir and pop the pie in the oven.
intro.little: We chop and stir and bake the pie!

intro.big: The pie smells so good. Chip adds a drizzle of chocolate on top!
intro.little: Chip adds chocolate on top. Yum!

ending.big: Ding! The pie is ready, and everyone at the picnic gives a big cheer!
ending.little: Ding! The pie is ready! Let's cheer!

ending.big: We chew and munch on warm, sweet cherry pie. The little chick has some too.
ending.little: We chew and munch on warm, sweet cherry pie. The little chick has some too.

ending.big: Chip draws a big thank you heart in chalk, just for us!
ending.little: Chip draws us a heart in chalk!

ending.big: You're a pie champion! A gold star for Chip's woods on our helper map!
ending.little: You're a pie champion! A gold star for our helper map!

stories.title: Theo's Big Show
stories.hook: Theo the bear's thunder drum is lost before his big show. Help find it!

intro.big: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a tiny thimble!
intro.little: Pelly the pelican brought us a letter. Oops! That's a tiny thimble!

intro.big: Here's the real letter. It's from Theo the bear. Come to his show at the forest theater!
intro.little: The real letter is from Theo the bear. Come to his show at the theater!

intro.big: We tiptoe through the thick green woods to the little stage under the trees.
intro.little: We tiptoe through the thick green woods to the little stage under the trees.

intro.big: Theo plays the thunder drum in the show, but his drum is lost! Let's find the thunder drum.
intro.little: Theo's thunder drum is lost! Let's find the thunder drum.

intro.big: Hmm, let's think. Where did Theo play it last? Behind the stage!
intro.little: Hmm, let's think. Where can it be?

intro.big: We peek behind a purple thistle. No drum, just a sleepy snail.
intro.little: We peek behind a purple thistle. No drum, just a sleepy snail.

intro.big: Thump, thump! We hear a noise behind the big bush. What is that?
intro.little: Thump, thump! What is that?

intro.big: It's the drum! A little squirrel is tapping it with a thin stick.
intro.little: It's the drum! A squirrel taps it with a thin stick.

ending.big: The show begins, and a thousand fireflies light up the stage.
ending.little: A thousand fireflies light up the show!

ending.big: Theo plays the drum. Thud, boom, thud! Everyone dances along.
ending.little: Theo plays the drum. Thud, boom, thud! Everyone dances along.

ending.big: Theo gives us a big bear hug. Thank you, friends!
ending.little: Theo gives us a hug. Thank you, friends!

ending.big: Two thumbs up! A gold star for Theo's theater on our helper map!
ending.little: Two thumbs up! A gold star for our helper map!
